:::: {.content-visible unless-profile="ja"}

The code below generates one PDF per manuscript figure. Expand **Show generation
code** to inspect each step. The PDFs use the same inputs, exclusions, GAMs, and
prediction grids as the analysis chapters; only the panel layout and typography
change. They are downloadable files rather than embedded figures on this page.

[Download the generation notebook (QMD)](../outputs/figures/submission/generate_figures.qmd){download="generate_figures.qmd"}

Figures 1–3 use the dimensions and arrangement of the figures embedded in the
current manuscript: approximately 114 × 228, 137 × 206, and 67 × 201 mm.
Each panel has a square plotting region. Species are arranged in rows and
traits in columns, with shared vertical labels, italic species names, and panel
letters inside the frames. Figure S2 is 120 mm wide. Text uses Arial, and the
PDFs retain vector lines and text. Corrected $E_t A$ values and units are retained.

Tensile stiffness is calculated as `E_t * A`, with `A = thick * width.x` from
the instrument dimensions (mm) associated with `E.x` (MPa). The resulting
`EA` is in N; bending-to-tensile stiffness ratios are in mm².

## Preparation

Run data integration first. Figure S2 also requires the stiffness comparison
chapter, which saves its data and fitted regressions without refitting here.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

以下のコードで、論文の図ごとに1つのPDFを作成します。コード欄を展開すると各手順を確認できます。入力、除外、GAM、予測用の格子点は解析の章と共通で、パネルの配置と文字の体裁を変更しています。PDFはページ内への埋め込みではなく、ダウンロードして確認できます。

[図生成用ノートブック（QMD）をダウンロード](../outputs/figures/submission/generate_figures.qmd){download="generate_figures.qmd"}

図1～3は、現在の原稿に埋め込まれた図の寸法と配置に合わせています（それぞれ約114 × 228、137 × 206、67 × 201 mm）。各パネルの描画領域は正方形です。行に種、列に形質を配置し、共通の縦軸ラベル、斜体の種名、枠内のパネル文字を使います。図S2の幅は120 mmです。文字はArialで、PDF内の線と文字はベクター形式です。修正後の $E_t A$ の値と単位を維持しています。

引張剛性は `E_t * A` として計算します。`A = thick * width.x` は、`E.x`（MPa）に対応する試験機の寸法（mm）から得ます。`EA` の単位はN、曲げ剛性と引張剛性の比の単位はmm²です。

## 準備

最初にデータ統合を実行してください。図S2には剛性比較の章も必要です。同章が保存したデータと回帰結果を読み込むため、ここでは再推定しません。

::::

```{r}
#| label: submission-preparation
#| code-summary: "Show generation code"
#| message: false
source("R/setup.R")
source("R/plot_submission_panels.R")
submission_dir <- "outputs/figures/submission"
dir.create(submission_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
invisible(file.copy("notebook/09-submission-figures.qmd",
                    file.path(submission_dir, "generate_figures.qmd"),
                    overwrite = TRUE))
bending <- read.csv("outputs/tables/bending.csv")
tensile <- add_tensile_stiffness(read.csv("outputs/tables/tensile.csv"))
species <- c("ubayuri", "youshuyamagobou", "yurinoki",
             "niseakashia", "aoki", "nezumimochi")
names(species) <- c("Cardiocrinum cordatum", "Phytolacca americana",
                   "Liriodendron tulipifera", "Robinia pseudoacacia",
                   "Aucuba japonica", "Ligustrum lucidum")
```

:::: {.content-visible unless-profile="ja"}

## Figure 1: Bending properties

A–F: bending stiffness; G–L: bending Young's modulus; M–R: second moment of
area. Orange circles and blue squares represent adaxial and abaxial bending.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

## 図1：曲げ特性

A～F：曲げ剛性、G～L：曲げ試験のヤング率、M～R：断面二次モーメント。オレンジの丸と青の四角は、それぞれ向軸側と背軸側の曲げを示します。

::::

```{r}
#| label: submission-figure-1
#| code-summary: "Show generation code"
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
data_bending <- bending[bending$water_content >= 60, ]
data_bending$EI <- data_bending$EI * 1000
data_bending$I <- data_bending$I * 1000
figure_1_models <- plot_submission_panels(
  data_bending, species, metrics = c("EI", "E.x", "I"),
  labels = expression("Bending stiffness"~(10^{-3}~N~mm^2),
                      "Young's modulus"~(MPa),
                      "Second moment of area"~(10^{-3}~mm^4)),
  file = file.path(submission_dir, "figure_1.pdf"))
```

:::: {.content-visible unless-profile="ja"}

[Download Figure 1 (PDF)](../outputs/figures/submission/figure_1.pdf){download="figure_1.pdf"}

## Figure 2: Tensile properties

A–F: tensile stiffness; G–L: tensile Young's modulus; M–R: tissue density;
S–X: modulus divided by tissue density.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

[図1（PDF）をダウンロード](../outputs/figures/submission/figure_1.pdf){download="figure_1.pdf"}

## 図2：引張特性

A～F：引張剛性、G～L：引張試験のヤング率、M～R：組織密度、S～X：ヤング率を組織密度で除した値。

::::

```{r}
#| label: submission-figure-2
#| code-summary: "Show generation code"
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
data_tensile <- tensile[tensile$water_content >= 60, ]

data_tensile$I <- data_tensile$I * 1000
data_tensile$density <- data_tensile$dry_weight / data_tensile$thickness
data_tensile$E_per_density <- data_tensile$E.x / data_tensile$density * 1000
figure_2_models <- plot_submission_panels(
  data_tensile, species, metrics = c("EA", "E.x", "density", "E_per_density"),
  labels = expression("Tensile stiffness"~(N), "Young's modulus"~(MPa),
                      "Leaf tissue density"~(kg~m^{-3}),
                      "Young's modulus / density"~(MPa~cm^3~g^{-1})),
  file = file.path(submission_dir, "figure_2.pdf"), tensile = TRUE)
```

:::: {.content-visible unless-profile="ja"}

[Download Figure 2 (PDF)](../outputs/figures/submission/figure_2.pdf){download="figure_2.pdf"}

## Figure 3: Bending-to-tensile ratios

A–F: stiffness ratio; G–L: Young's modulus ratio. The reference lines for the
modulus ratio are at 1 and 3, as in the analysis chapter.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

[図2（PDF）をダウンロード](../outputs/figures/submission/figure_2.pdf){download="figure_2.pdf"}

## 図3：曲げ特性と引張特性の比

A～F：剛性比、G～L：ヤング率の比。ヤング率の比の基準線は解析の章と同じく1と3です。

::::

```{r}
#| label: submission-figure-3
#| code-summary: "Show generation code"
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
ratios <- merge(
  bending[, c("spp", "leaf_side", "ID", "EI", "E.x", "water_content")],
  tensile[, c("spp", "ID1", "EA", "E.x", "water_content")],
  all = TRUE, suffixes = c("_bending", "_tensile"),
  by.x = c("spp", "ID"), by.y = c("spp", "ID1"))
ratios <- ratios[ratios$water_content_bending >= 60 &
                   ratios$water_content_tensile >= 60, ]
ratios$RWC_mean <- (ratios$water_content_bending + ratios$water_content_tensile) / 2
ratios$stiffness_ratio <- ratios$EI / ratios$EA * 1000
ratios$E_ratio <- ratios$E.x_bending / ratios$E.x_tensile
figure_3_models <- plot_submission_panels(
  ratios, species, metrics = c("stiffness_ratio", "E_ratio"),
  labels = expression("Bending stiffness / tensile stiffness"~(10^{-3}~mm^2),
                      "Bending / tensile Young's modulus"),
  file = file.path(submission_dir, "figure_3.pdf"), x = "RWC_mean",
  reference_lines = c(1, 3), label_offsets = c(0.045, 0.085))
```

## 図S2：剛性の相対的な低下

補足解析で保存した予測値と回帰結果を用います。モデルの当てはめはRWC 50%以上で行い、元の解析と同じく *Ligustrum lucidum* の背軸側を欠測とします。RWC 80%に最も近い格子点の予測値を維持しています。

::::

```{r}
#| label: submission-figure-s2
#| code-summary: "Show generation code"
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
comparison <- readRDS("outputs/tables/stiffness-comparison.rds")
plot_submission_comparison(comparison, file.path(submission_dir, "figure_S2.pdf"))
```
